text:
debrief db-021
row 1: the actor a-g-r-e-e-d with the two competitors on a fixed rotation order for winning each tender phase | s-i-g-n-e-d a sealed side letter naming the three bidders and their turn order | e-v-a-d-e-d the anti-collusion attestations filed with the bid package | r-e-v-i-e-w of all signed attachments against the rotation schedule
row 2: the actors s-h-a-r-e-d exact unit pricing across competing bids | e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d spreadsheets with identical material cost lines via a shared drive | e-v-a-d-e-d the pricing-difference threshold test used by the panel | c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n of unit prices across all received bids
row 3: the losing bidders s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d deliberately high cover bids to fake competition | d-r-a-f-t-e-d quotations inflated roughly 30 to 40 percent above market rates | e-v-a-d-e-d the low-price anomaly screen that flags unusually cheap offers | s-t-a-t-i-s-t-i-c-a-l review of bid spread and outlier margins
row 4: the winner paid hidden compensation to the cover bidders after contract award | t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s through a shell invoicing company listed as consulting fees | e-v-a-d-e-d the declared-interest disclosures in the tender documents | b-a-c-k-w-a-r-d m-a-t-c-h-i-n-g of post-award payments against the losing firms
row 5: the panel was pressured to certify competitiveness on schedule | p-r-e-s-e-n-t-e-d a pre-written evaluation matrix already ranking the rotating winner | e-v-a-d-e-d the independent re-scoring step of the evaluation protocol | i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t re-score of the matrix against raw bid data
